what: Pearson sells education: university and professional textbooks and courseware, English language testing, professional certification exams, and online programme management for universities.
customers: Students, universities, professional bodies and employers, mostly in English-speaking markets.
money: professional certification, school qualifications and clinical assessment
Pearson Test of English and language courses
moat: Accreditation and exam franchises: a professional certification delivered by Pearson is recognised by the bodies that require it, and that recognition cannot be competed away quickly.
risks: American university textbook revenue keeps declining as students buy used or rent
AI tools can produce study material that competes with paid courseware
Only two analysts cover the American listing and their target is below the price
opportunities: 11.9 times free cash flow with $857M of free cash flow against a $10.2B market value
The assessment and certification businesses grow steadily and do not depend on textbooks
Revenue grew from $4.5B to $4.8B last year after several flat years
watch: Assessment and Qualifications growth, and whether Higher Education stops shrinking.
